Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Neeta - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vimla - 68 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Neeta, Kavya and Vimla stand near him.]

Kavya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya catches the ball.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Neeta: "Really?"

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Kavya: "I knew it!"

[Aditya goes down the slide.]

Neeta: "Kavya, look at this."

[Aditya plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Kavya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya plays with his dog.]

Aditya (gently): "Careful!"

[Aditya feeds the birds.]

Neeta (gently): "That's easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Kavya and Neeta stand near him.]

Aditya: "Let's begin."

[Aditya folds his hands and prays.]

Kavya: "I'm ready!"

[Aditya lights a diya.]

Neeta (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Kavya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Kavya (happily): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aditya paints a picture.]

Aditya (softly): "Exactly right."

[Aditya draws a picture of the house.]

Aditya (softly): "That's easy."

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

[Aditya stands in the snow. Neeta, Kavya and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "So, here we are!"

[Snow starts to fall.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya builds a snowman.]

Aditya: "Really?"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Neeta and Vimla stand near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya eats his breakfast at the table.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

[Aditya takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Aditya (excited): "That's easy."

[Aditya sips hot tea from a cup.]

Aditya (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Aditya: "That was such a fun day!"
